title: Report: Working from Home Proposal
prompt:
You work for a company that is considering offering employees the option to work from home two days a week. Your manager has asked you to write a report evaluating the advantages and disadvantages of this proposal and making recommendations.

Write your report in 220-260 words.
notes: Look for: a short, appropriately formal/semi-formal register; clear headed sections (e.g. Introduction, Advantages, Disadvantages, Recommendations) rather than essay-style paragraphs; objective, impersonal language (avoid 'I think'); specific, plausible points rather than generic ones; a clear final recommendation that follows logically from the points raised.
